title: Celebrate Success: Fourth of July Weekend Sales
description: Celebrate yacht sales success this Fourth of July weekend as we spotlight six luxury vessels that found new owners, showcasing style and elegance.
html:
This Fourth of July weekend marked an exciting wave of success as several exceptional yachts found their new owners. As fireworks lit up the skies, our team was proud to help make dreams come true for yacht enthusiasts across the coast. Below, we highlight six standout vessels that were sold, each representing the luxury, performance, and style our clients seek.

72′ Sunseeker

72’ Sunseeker 2006

A true testament to British craftsmanship, this 72’ Sunseeker blended elegance with performance. With her sleek profile, spacious flybridge, and opulent interior, she delivered both comfort and class for cruising or entertaining. A strong performer in the open water, this model continues to be a favorite for long-range adventures.

57′ Okean


57’ Okean 2025

Sold before she even hit the water, this brand-new 2025 Okean 57 delivered modern innovation at its finest. With open-concept decks, fold-out balconies, and a futuristic silhouette, she was designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Her new owner will enjoy cutting-edge design and the thrill of commanding one of the market’s boldest offerings.

50′ Sea Ray 500 Sundancer


50’ Sea Ray 2010

Combining sporty looks with a practical layout, this 2010 Sea Ray 50 was the ideal family cruiser. She offered a spacious salon, well-equipped galley, and two staterooms for weekend getaways or day trips. Reliable power and stylish finishes made this Sea Ray an easy choice for her new owners.

43′ Azimut


43’ Azimut 2016

A head-turner in any marina, the 43’ Azimut balanced Italian luxury with efficient cruising. Her sleek lines, panoramic windows, and finely appointed interiors reflected Azimut’s reputation for blending style and performance. She now begins her next chapter with owners who value elegance and adventure in equal measure.

47′ Sea Ray 470 Sundancer


47’ Sea Ray 2011

This 2011 Sea Ray 47 offered a sleek profile, versatile cockpit, and well-thought-out interior design. She was equally ready for daytime entertaining or overnight trips, with powerful twin diesel engines and refined Sea Ray engineering. Her timeless appeal made her a standout on the market.

33′ NHD


33’ NHD 2025

Fresh from the factory, this 2025 NHD 33 brought modern flair in a compact footprint. With her aggressive styling, bold lines, and premium finishes, she was built for boaters seeking performance and personality. The perfect choice for day cruising, this vessel now sails under proud new ownership.


Looking Ahead

We’re thrilled to have helped these vessels find their next adventures at sea. Whether you’re looking to sell or searching for the perfect yacht, our team at FYI Yachts is here to guide you every step of the way. Congratulations to the new owners, and stay tuned for more exciting listings and success stories!
